'''Jesper Altax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] whom, at some point before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. He was redeemed after some [[Time/Legends|time]] and his experiences were later stored in the [[Noetikon of Secrets]].
